z-m-07-09.title: Bhekari inofanira kubika red bean buns dzingani Muvhuro unotevera?
z-m-07-09.topic: Kufungidzira zviri mberi kubva pamarekodhi ekutengesa (kubata outlier)
z-m-07-09.goal: Ziva kuti kana uchifungidzira zviri mberi kubva pamarekodhi, nzira yekubata outlier inoenderana nechikonzero, uye chinja kufungidzira kwako nechivimbo chako neruzivo rutsva, uchizvinyora mu note.
z-m-07-09.material: Bhekari yedhorobha inobika red bean buns dzekutengesa zuva iroro mangwanani ega ega. Kana ikabika dzakawanda zvikuru, dzimwe dzinosara, uye kana ikabika shoma zvikuru, dzinopera. Muridzi anoda kusarudza kuti abike red bean buns dzingani Muvhuro unotevera nekutarisa marekodhi ekutengesa evhiki rapfuura. Vhiki rapfuura chitoro chakavhurika zuva rega rega kubva Muvhuro kusvika Chishanu.

z-m-07-01.title: Chigadzirwa chenhamba ine mavara maviri nenhamba ine vara rimwe nguva dzose chinova nhamba ine mavara matatu here?
z-m-07-01.topic: Kusarudza kuti chigadzirwa che (nhamba ine mavara maviri)×(nhamba ine vara rimwe) chine mavara mangani
z-m-07-01.goal: Ziva kuti mienzaniso mishoma yakarurama haiiti 'nguva dzose,' gadzira mienzaniso yako umo chigadzirwa chenhamba ine mavara maviri nenhamba ine vara rimwe chiri nhamba ine mavara maviri, uye utaure kuti chinova nhamba ine mavara matatu rinhi.
z-m-07-01.material:
Doyun akasarudza matambudziko ekuwanza wakataura izvi.
'37×4=148, 52×6=312, 78×9=702. Chigadzirwa chenhamba ine mavara maviri nenhamba ine vara rimwe nguva dzose chinova nhamba ine mavara matatu!'
(Pano nhamba ine mavara maviri inhamba kubva pa 10 kusvika pa 99, uye nhamba ine vara rimwe inhamba kubva pa 2 kusvika pa 9. 37×4 inoverengwa se 'makumi matatu nenomwe nguva ina.')
z-m-07-01.thinking.0: Tarisa kana mienzaniso yakawanda yakarurama ichipa chokwadi che 'nguva dzose'
z-m-07-01.thinking.2: Taura mutemo unoparadzanisa pachaita zvichiri zvechokwadi napasingaiti
z-m-07-01.prereq.0: Verenga mafomula ekuwanza enhamba ine mavara maviri nenhamba ine vara rimwe uye utsvage kukosha (chiyero cheGredhi 3)
z-m-07-01.prereq.1: Ziva kuti 100 ndiyo nhamba yekutanga ine mavara matatu
z-m-07-01.s.s1.prompt: Unofungei pamusoro pezvakataurwa naDoyun? Tonga mukati memiganho yakagadzirwa: nhamba dzine mavara maviri ndedzokubva pa 10 kusvika pa 99 uye nhamba dzine vara rimwe ndedzokubva pa 2 kusvika pa 9.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora padivi pomumwe nhamba dzakaedzwa naDoyun, 37, 52, ne 78, nenhamba dzaakawanza nadzo, 4, 6, ne 9, uye utsvage mamiriro asina kuedzwa naye.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.hint.1: Wanza nhamba mbiri diki dziri mukati momuganho nenhamba mbiri huru, uye ufungidzire kuti chigadzirwa chiri mumuganho upi.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.o.a: Wakawanza nenhamba ine vara rimwe, saka chigadzirwa nguva dzose chinova nhamba ine mavara maviri
z-m-07-01.s.s1.r.a: Nhamba ine mavara maviri kuva chinowanzwa chine vara rimwe hakuiti kuti chigadzirwa chive nhamba ine mavara maviri. Tarisa kuti chigadzirwa che 78×9, chakapiwa naDoyun, chine mavara mangani.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.o.b: Kana nhamba ine vara rimwe iri 9, chigadzirwa nguva dzose chinova nhamba ine mavara matatu
z-m-07-01.s.s1.r.b: Kunyange kuwanza na 9 kunogona kupa nhamba ine mavara maviri. Tarisa kuti chigadzirwa che 10×9 chii.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.o.c: Mienzaniso yose mitatu yakarurama, saka Doyun akarurama
z-m-07-01.s.s1.r.c: Muenzaniso kuva wakarurama kwakasiyana nokuva wakarurama "nguva dzose." Unofanira kutarisa kana pane mamiriro asati aedzwa.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.o.d: Dzimwe nguva inova nhamba ine mavara matatu uye dzimwe nguva ine mavara maviri
z-m-07-01.s.s1.r.d: Iyi ipfungwa yokuti huwandu hwemavara echigadzirwa hunogona kuchinja zvichienderana nehukuru henhamba mbiri dzinowanzwa. Zvinojeka kana ukagadzira mienzaniso woitarisa.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.explain: Chigadzirwa chidiki mumuganho ndi 10×2=20 uye chigadzirwa chikuru ndi 99×9=891. Saka chigadzirwa chinogona kuva nhamba ine mavara maviri kana matatu, uye hachigoni kuva nhamba ine mavara mana.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mienzaniso miviri ine zvigadzirwa zvakasiyana inoratidza kuti kutaura kwaDoyun hakuna kururama. Sarudza nhamba a ine mavara maviri (10 kusvika 99) nenhamba b ine vara rimwe (2 kusvika 9) kuti chigadzirwa chisave nhamba ine mavara matatu.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza nhamba diki kutanga uzvidzanise, uye utarise kuti chigadzirwa chine mavara mangani.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza a imwe, wobva wachinja b kuva 2, 3, 4, ... uye utsvage pachinotanga kuva nhamba ine mavara matatu.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Ita a nhamba yechisikigo kubva pa 10 kusvika pa 99.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.ok.c2: b inhamba ine vara rimwe (2 kusvika 9).
z-m-07-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Ita b nhamba yechisikigo kubva pa 2 kusvika pa 9.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.ok.c3: Chigadzirwa chiri pasi pe 100, saka hachisi nhamba ine mavara matatu. Kutaura kwaDoyun kwaputswa.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Chigadzirwa inhamba ine mavara matatu kana kupfuura. Chinja a kana b kuti chigadzirwa chive chidiki.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, 12×3=36, 20×4=80, ne 45×2=90 zvose nhamba dzine mavara maviri. 50×2=100 ndiko kutanga kwenhamba dzine mavara matatu, saka hausi muenzaniso. Kunyange muenzaniso mumwe unopesana unoputsa 'nguva dzose.'
z-m-07-01.s.s3.prompt: Ungada kuudzei Doyun? Uchishandisa mienzaniso yawakangogadzira, nyora kuti sei akanganisa, uye nyorawo kuti chigadzirwa chinova nhamba ine mavara matatu rinhi.
z-m-07-01.s.s3.hint.0: Unogona kushandisa mafomula ekuwanza emienzaniso yawakagadzira pakutanga sezvazvakaita.
z-m-07-01.s.s3.hint.1: Funga kuti ndiyo nhamba ipi inoparadzanisa nhamba dzine mavara maviri nedzine mavara matatu.
z-m-07-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Mumuenzaniso wako, wakaverenga zvakare kuti utarise kuti chigadzirwa chenhamba ine mavara maviri nenhamba ine vara rimwe chaizvo inhamba ine mavara maviri here?
z-m-07-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora uchiziva here kuti muenzaniso mumwe unokwana kuputsa 'nguva dzose'?
z-m-07-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakataura here kuti chinova nhamba ine mavara matatu rinhi nenhamba (semuenzaniso, 99×9) kana mutemo (100 kana kupfuura)?
z-m-07-01.s.s3.model.0: Zvakataurwa naDoyun hazvisi zvechokwadi nguva dzose. Pane mamiriro umo inova nhamba ine mavara maviri, semuenzaniso 12×3=36. Kana nhamba mbiri dziri huru uye chigadzirwa chikapfuura 100, chinova nhamba ine mavara matatu.
z-m-07-01.s.s3.model.1: Kwete. 20×4=80 inhamba ine mavara maviri. Nhamba mbiri dzinowanzwa dzichikura, chigadzirwa chinokurawo, saka chinogona kuva nhamba ine mavara matatu semuenzaniso 99×9=891.
z-m-07-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Mhinduro inoti 'nhamba dzikuru' panzvimbo pomutemo une 'kana 100 kana kupfuura' inobvumirwawo.
z-m-07-01.s.s3.model.2: Nhamba ine mavara maviri inogonawo kubuda, semuenzaniso 12×3=36, saka Doyun akanganisa. Chigadzirwa chinofanira kupfuura 100 kuti chive nhamba ine mavara matatu.

z-m-07-03.title: Ndakagovanisa nhamba iri pakadhi ne6 uye quotient yakava 7. Nhamba iri pakadhi ndeipi?
z-m-07-03.topic: Kuwana chiyero chedividend kubva paquotient neremainder yekugovanisa kune remainder
z-m-07-03.goal: Ziva kuti quotient yoga haigadzike dividend kuita nhamba imwe, nongedza ruzivo rwakashaikwa (remainder), uye wana nhamba dzakawanda dzinokodzera mamiriro uye nhamba huru zvikuru.
z-m-07-03.material: Soyul akafukidza kadhi renhamba noruoko rwake ndokuti, 'Nhamba iri pakadhi iri nhamba yechisikigo. Ndakaigovanisa ne6 uye quotient yakava 7.' Soyul haasati ataura kana pane remainder kana kwete.
z-m-07-03.prereq.0: Ziva zvinoreva quotient neremainder mukugovanisa kune remainder (ukuru hwegiredhi 3)
z-m-07-03.s.s1.prompt: Nhamba iri pakadhi inogona kugadzikwa kuita imwe kubva pamashoko aSoyul oga here? Ungada kuziva chii chimwe kuti ugadzike kuita imwe?
z-m-07-03.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga wanyora nhamba diki zvikuru ine quotient ye7. Wedzera 1, 2, 3, ... kwairi uye uongorore kana quotient ichiri 7.
z-m-07-03.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora makandidate ose, uye uwane kuti ruzivo rumwe rwekuwedzera rwaizosiya imwe chete.
z-m-07-03.s.s1.o.a: Unoda kuziva zvakawanda nezvekuti remainder yakakura sei
z-m-07-03.s.s1.r.a: Kunyange kana quotient yakafanana, kana remainder yakasiyana, dividend yakasiyana. Kana uchiziva remainder, unogona kugadzika kuita imwe yemakandidate.
z-m-07-03.s.s1.o.b: Unoda kuziva zvakawanda nezvekuti iodd kana even
z-m-07-03.s.s1.r.b: Kana uchiziva odd kana even, makandidate anodzika, asi haagadzikwi kuita imwe. Verenga makandidate eeven mangani nemakandidate eodd mangani aunogona kugadzira.
z-m-07-03.s.s1.o.c: Unoda kuziva zvakawanda nezvekuti divisor 6 yakarurama here
z-m-07-03.s.s1.r.c: Soyul atoudza divisor 6. Chisina kugadzikwa ichokwadi chimwe.
z-m-07-03.s.s1.r.d: 42 imwe yemakandidate, asi kana pane remainder, haisi 42. Soyul haana kuti inogovanika zvakaenzana.
z-m-07-03.s.s1.explain: Kana quotient i7, nhamba iri pakadhi imwe ye42, 43, 44, 45, 46, 47 (remainder i0 kusvika pa5). Kana uchiziva remainder, yagadzikwa kuita imwe. Neodd kana even oga, 3 dzinosara dzega dzega.
z-m-07-03.s.s2.prompt: Ngatiti nhamba iri pakadhi haigovanikwi ne6. Nyora nhamba 3 dzakasiyana dziri pakadhi dzine quotient ye7 uye dzine remainder.
z-m-07-03.s.s2.hint.0: Ongorora kana pane remainder mushure mekubvisa 6 kubva panhamba iri pakadhi nguva 7.
z-m-07-03.s.s2.hint.1: Govanisa nhamba yega yega pakati pe42 ne48 ne6 rimwe panguva uye uongorore kana quotient i7 uye remainder isiri 0.
z-m-07-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Ita nhamba iri pakadhi nhamba yechisikigo i1 kana kupfuura.
z-m-07-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Quotient kana yagoverwa ne6 haisi 7. Verenga kuti 6 inogona kubviswa kangani.
z-m-07-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Inogovanika zvakaenzana ne6. Ichinje kuita nhamba ine remainder isiri 0.
z-m-07-03.s.s2.explain: Nhamba dzine quotient ye7 uye dzine remainder i43, 44, 45, 46, 47, shanu dzazvo. Idzi i42 pamwe neremainders 1 kusvika 5.
z-m-07-03.s.s3.prompt: Nhamba iri pakadhi inogona kuva nhamba huru zvikuru ipi? Tsanangura kuti nei nhamba iyoyo iri huru zvikuru uchiibatanidza neremainder.
z-m-07-03.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora nhamba dzinogona kuva remainder rimwe panguva uchitanga pa0 uye utarise kwaunofanira kumira.
z-m-07-03.s.s3.hint.1: Ienzanise nenhamba diki zvikuru ine quotient ye8.
z-m-07-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakaongorora kuti kugovanisa nhamba yawakanyora ne6 chaizvo kunopa quotient ye7 here?
z-m-07-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakatsanangura kuti nei remainder isingagoni kuva 6 kana kupfuura here?
z-m-07-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakanyora hukama hwekuti kana remainder iri huru zvikuru, dividend inova huru zvikurufuru here?
z-m-07-03.s.s3.model.0: I47. Remainder inofanira kuva pasi pe divisor 6, saka remainder huru zvikuru i5. 42 pamwe ne5 i47.
z-m-07-03.s.s3.model.1: I47. Kana yagoverwa ne6 remainder inogona kuva 0 kusvika 5 chete, saka kana remainder i5, 42+5=47 ndiyo huru zvikuru.
z-m-07-03.s.s3.modelNote.1: Iyi tsananguro inotanga ne6×7=42 uye inowedzera remainder.

z-m-07-07.title: Kirasi ye '75-minute' mu notice yekushambira inopera rini?
z-m-07-07.topic: Kuverenga nguva yezuva nehurefu hwenguva (maminetsi) nekuverenga notice
z-m-07-07.goal: Ongorora kana ruzivo rwenguva mu notice runosimbisa nguva yekupera sechimwe, taura ruzivo rwuri kushaikwa (kana kuzorora kwakasanganisirwa), uye unyore zvakare notice kuti vabereki varege kunzwisisa zvisizvo.
z-m-07-07.material:

z-m-07-08.title: Tinogona kuziva mhedzisiro yakabatanidzwa tisingazivi huwandu hwema votes ekirasi imwe neimwe here?
z-m-07-08.topic: Kuverenga mhedzisiro dzema votes maviri pamwe chete (ruzivo rwemusiyano)
z-m-07-08.goal: Ziva kuti ruzivo rwunodiwa kana uchibatanidza ma votes harusi 'huwandu hwema votes ekirasi imwe neimwe' asi 'mangani akawanda,' uye utarise utsanangure nekugadzira mienzaniso yakati wandei ine huwandu hwema votes hwakasiyana.
z-m-07-08.material:
Kirasi 1 neKirasi 2 yeGiredhi 3 yakasarudza nzvimbo yeshanyo yepakoreji nekuvhota. Nzvimbo i zoo nemuseum, uye munhu wese akavhota kamwe chete.
Mhedzisiro yeKirasi 1: Zoo yakawana ma votes 3 akawanda kupfuura museum.
Mhedzisiro yeKirasi 2: Museum yakawana ma votes 2 akawanda kupfuura zoo.
Hatisati taziva kuti ma votes mangani akabuda pamwe chete mukirasi imwe neimwe, kana kuti zoo nemuseum imwe neimwe yakawana ma votes mangani. Chikoro chakasarudza kubatanidza ma votes ekirasi mbiri uye kuenda kune ine akawanda.
z-m-07-08.thinking.1: Gadzira iwe pachako mienzaniso inogutsa mamiriro
z-m-07-08.prereq.0: Kuverenga huwandu hwema votes echinhu chimwe nechimwe mutebhura nekuvaenzanisa (padanho regiredhi re3)
z-m-07-08.prereq.1: Ruzivo rwekutarisa mhedzisiro dzema votes nekubatanidza makirasi maviri
z-m-07-08.s.s1.prompt: Kana tikabatanidza ma votes ekirasi mbiri, nzvimbo ipi ine ma votes mangani akawanda? Tinogona kuziva here?
z-m-07-08.s.s1.hint.0: Sarudza seti imwe yema votes inoenderana nemhedzisiro yeKirasi 1 neseti imwe inoenderana nemhedzisiro yeKirasi 2, uye ubatanidze ma votes ekirasi mbiri.
z-m-07-08.s.s1.hint.1: Sarudza huwandu hwema votes zvakasiyana kamwe zvakare uye uenzanise kana musiyano wakabatanidzwa unochinja.
z-m-07-08.s.s1.r.a: Uku i kutonga kwakafunga kuti chii chinoitika kumusiyano wakabatanidzwa kana zoo iri mberi mukirasi imwe uye museum iri mberi mune imwe. Sarudza muenzaniso mumwe uye utarise.
z-m-07-08.s.s1.o.b: Hatigone kuziva. Tinofanira kuziva huwandu hwema votes mukirasi imwe neimwe
z-m-07-08.s.s1.r.b: Kunyange tisingazivi huwandu hwema votes mukirasi imwe neimwe, kana uchiziva "ma votes mangani akawanda," unogona kuwana musiyano wakabatanidzwa. Sarudza huwandu hwemuenzaniso hwema votes uye uzvibatanidze iwe pachako.
z-m-07-08.s.s1.r.c: Funga kwakabva 3 ne 5. MuKirasi 2, museum yaiva neyakawanda. Musiyano uyu unofanira kuratidzwa sei mumhedzisiro yakabatanidzwa?
z-m-07-08.s.s1.r.d: Inosarudzwa nehuwandu hwakabatanidzwa hwema votes, kwete nehuwandu hwenguva imwe neimwe kirasi yakakunda. Kuva mberi ne ma votes 3 nekuva mberi ne ma votes 2 i hukuru hwakasiyana.
z-m-07-08.s.s1.explain: Semuenzaniso, kana Kirasi 1 i ma votes 14 ku 11 uye Kirasi 2 i ma votes 9 ku 11, wakabatanidzwa zoo ine ma votes 23 uye museum 22, saka zoo ine vote 1 yakawanda. Kana Kirasi 1 i ma votes 5 ku 2 uye Kirasi 2 i ma votes 3 ku 5, zoo ine 8 uye museum 7, zvakare musiyano we vote 1. Kunyange kana huwandu hwema votes ekirasi imwe neimwe hwakasiyana, kana uchiziva 'mangani akawanda' chete, musiyano wakabatanidzwa i vote 1, musiyano pakati pe ma votes 3 ne ma votes 2.
z-m-07-08.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mienzaniso miviri, ine huwandu hwevanhu vakavhota hwakasiyana, apo Kirasi 1 ine ma votes 3 akawanda ezoo uye Kirasi 2 ine ma votes 2 akawanda emuseum. Kirasi 1 ine ma votes z1 ezoo ne b1 emuseum, uye Kirasi 2 ine ma votes z2 ezoo ne b2 emuseum. Kirasi imwe neimwe ine vanhu vakavhota 30 kana vashoma.
z-m-07-08.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza uye unyore seti imwe yenhamba dzema votes apo zoo ine ma votes 3 akawanda kupfuura museum muKirasi 1.
z-m-07-08.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza Kirasi 2 zvakare, wobva waenzanisa ma votes ezoo nemuseum akabatanidzwa ekirasi mbiri.

z-m-07-08.s.s2.fail.c1: Ita huwandu hwema votes natural numbers dze 0 kana kupfuura.

Kunyange kana huwandu hwema votes hwakasiyana, musiyano wakabatanidzwa wakafanana.

z-m-07-08.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakanyorawo zvakaparadzana zvisingagoni kuzikanwa kubva pakubatanidza (semuenzaniso, zoo yakawana ma votes mangani) here?

z-m-07-08.s.s3.modelNote.0: Mhinduro iyi haina kutaura zvakaparadzana kuti huwandu hwema votes enzvimbo imwe neimwe hunosiyana kubva pamuenzaniso kuenda kune mumwe.

z-m-07-04.material: Yoona ari kugadzira necklace, achiverenga mabead kubva kumberi se 1st, 2nd, 3rd, ... Mavara emabead ari matatu: tsvuku, bhuruu, nevhudzi, uye zvinoita sekuti pane mutemo wemavara aanosunga. Ndichakuudza mavara nemashoko chete.
z-m-07-04.thinking.0: Fungidzira mutemo kubva pachikamu chedata uye uuedze

z-m-07-04.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora mabead anozivikanwa kusvika zvino padivi nedivi, uchibatanidza nhamba nemavara.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.hint.1: Wana nhamba umo kurongeka kwemavara kwakafanana kunotangazve kekutanga.

z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Unofunga bead rechi7 richava ruvara rupi?

z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uku kufungidzira kuti tsvuku, bhuruu, bhuruu, yero zvinodzokororwa. Tangopfuura seti imwe zvishoma, saka kuvimba hakukuru.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakafunga here kuti sezvo yero yakauya pachi4, ichauyawo pachi7? Tarisa daro pakati penhamba umo yero yakauya nenhamba 7.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Unofunga kuti sezvo tsvuku yakauya pachi5, tsvuku ichaenderera. Tarisa kuti rechi6, pakarepo mushure mechi5, raiva ruvara rupi.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Hatigoni kusarudza zvino kubva pa6 chete
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Kungwarira nokuti mabead mashoma anoonekwa maitiro akanaka. Kunyange zvakadaro, tarisa kana pane chiratidzo chaunogona kuwana mumabead anoonekwa.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Zvadaro, mavara emabead 7 kusvika 12, nenzira, aiva bhuruu, yero, tsvuku, bhuruu, bhuruu, yero. Zvino mabead 1 kusvika 12 ose asimbiswa.

z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Rondedzera nhamba umo yero yakauya, 4, 8, 12, uye uenderere uchinyora kuona kana 25 iri pakati pazvo.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kungwarira kwakanaka, asi kana ukaverenga kuti pateni imwe chete yakadzokororwa kangani mukati me12, unogona kuwana zvimwe zviratidzo.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Enderera uchinyora nhamba umo bhuruu yakauya, 2, 3, 6, 7, 10, 11, uye uongorore kana 25 iri pakati pazvo.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Uku kutonga kwakatora maseti anodzokororwa ne4 ega ega uye kwakanongedza kuti 25 inowira papi museti itsva.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Hanzi nhau itsva. Mushure mekuti necklace yapera, takatarisa bead rechi30 uye raiva yero. (Tichiri kusaziva mabead 13 kusvika 29.)

Saka 'tsvuku, asi isina chokwadi chakadii' ne 'hatigoni kusarudza' zvinonzwisisika, uye 'chokwadi' kana 'yero' hazvina hwaro.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Rechi30 nerechi25 nhamba dzakasiyana. Fungidzira kana kuva kweyero kwerechi30 kuchigadzika ruvara rwerechi25 zvakananga.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Tanga waongorora kana rechi30 riri ruvara runopiwa nemutemo. Shanda kuti rechi30 raifanira kuva ruvara rupi dai mutemo wakashanda.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ndichiri kufunga kuti ritsvuku asi handina chokwadi sapakutanga
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Uku kutonga kwekuti kunyange kana ruzivo rutsva rwunogona kuzunza mutemo, kana nzvimbo yakazunzwa iri mushure me25, rechi25 rinogona kuramba rakadaro.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Mutemo ungangova wakachinja pakati, saka rechi25 haringagoni kusarudzwa

z-m-07-06.prereq.1: Perimeter yechimiro i hurefu hwekutenderera kamwe mucheto wacho
z-m-07-06.s.s1.hint.0: Gadzira ma right triangles maviri (3 cm, 4 cm, 5 cm) kubva papepa uye udhirowe zvimiro zvaunowana painochinja divi rinonamatidzwa. Kana pasina pepa, fungidzira right angle sekona rebhuku uye uite mundangariro.
z-m-07-06.s.s1.hint.1: Muchimiro chakanamatidzwa, tarisa kana ma angles ese mana i right angles uye kana chine mativi mana.
z-m-07-06.s.s1.r.a: Uku i kutonga kwekuti uchatarisa nekuchinja divi rinonamatidzwa nenzira yaunoriisa. Zvinojeka kana ukawana kuti ndiko kuri rectangle.
z-m-07-06.s.s1.r.b: Unoziva ma right angles nehurefu hwemativi, saka unogona kushanda mundangariro kunyange usati wanamatidza pepa. Yeuka kana ma angles ese mana e rectangle i right angles.
z-m-07-06.s.s1.o.c: Zvisinei kuti unovanamatidza sei, haina kuva rectangle
z-m-07-06.s.s1.r.c: Wakatarisa kana pachena pasina nzira yekunamatidza inogadzira rectangle here? Tarisa zvakare chiitiko chekunamatidza mativi marefu zvikuru.
z-m-07-06.s.s1.o.d: Zvisinei kuti unovanamatidza sei, inova rectangle
z-m-07-06.s.s1.r.d: Uku i kutonga kwakatevera chirevo chaSeoa sezvachakaita. Gadzirawo utarise chiitiko chekunamatidza mativi e 3 cm iwe pachako.
z-m-07-06.s.s1.explain: Kana ukanamatidza mativi e 5 cm, uchitendeudza chidimbu chimwe, inova rectangle ine upamhi 3 cm nekureba 4 cm. Kana ukanamatidza mativi e 3 cm, kupindura chidimbu chimwe kunopa triangle hombe uye kutendeudza chidimbu chimwe kunopa chimiro chine mativi mana chakarerekera, saka haisi rectangle. Saka zvinoenderana nedivi rinonamatidzwa nenzira.
z-m-07-06.s.s2.prompt: Ngatiwane perimeter yechimiro chakanamatidzwa. Huwandu hwemativi ese matatu e right triangle imwe i 12 cm. Kana uchinamatidza mativi ehurefu hwakafanana, ngatitii hurefu hwedivi rinonamatidzwa i j cm (rimwe re 3, 4, 5), uye wana zviitiko zviviri zvakasiyana apo perimeter yechimiro chaunogadzira i refu kupfuura 14 cm.
z-m-07-06.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wawana huwandu hwema perimeter ezvidimbu zviviri.
z-m-07-06.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa nepepa kana divi rinonamatidzwa richisara pamucheto wechimiro, uye ubvise hurefu husingasare.
z-m-07-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Divi rinonamatidzwa rinofanira kuva rimwe re 3, 4, 5 cm. Zviviri zvakafanana, saka unonamatidza mativi ehurefu hwakafanana.
z-m-07-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Perimeter haisi refu kupfuura 14 cm. Tarisa kana pane divi rakavanzwa kana rakanamatidzwa.
z-m-07-06.s.s2.explain: Perimeter yechidimbu chimwe i 3+4+5=12 cm, saka zvidimbu zviviri zvinoita 24 cm. Divi rinonamatidzwa rinoenda mukati uye rinovanzwa pazvidimbu zvese. Kunamatidza divi re 3 cm kunopa 24−6=18 cm, divi re 4 cm 24−8=16 cm, uye divi re 5 cm 24−10=14 cm. Perimeter refu kupfuura 14 cm inobva pakunamatidza divi re 3 cm kana 4 cm.
z-m-07-06.s.s3.prompt: Ungada kuudza Seoa chii? Pa nzira imwe yekunamatidza inogadzira rectangle neimwe isingagadzire, uye unyore kuti divi ripi rakanamatidzwa uye sei.
z-m-07-06.s.s3.hint.0: Yeuka zviitiko zvekunamatidza mativi e 3 cm, 4 cm, ne 5 cm zvawakashandisa pakuwana perimeter, rimwe panguva.
z-m-07-06.s.s3.hint.1: Verenga kuti chimiro chine ma right angles mangani mushure mekunamatidza.
z-m-07-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisa nema angles mana kuti chimiro chakagadzirwa nekunamatidza kwawakatsanangura chaizvo i (kana haisi) rectangle here?
z-m-07-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora zvakajeka kuti divi ripi rakanamatidzwa, nehurefu hwaro here?
z-m-07-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakanyora uchiziva kuti counterexample imwe yakakwana kuputsa 'nguva dzose' here?
z-m-07-06.s.s3.model.0: Hazvisi nguva dzose zvakadaro. Kana ukanamatidza mativi e 5 cm uye ukatendeudza chidimbu chimwe, unowana rectangle ine upamhi 3 cm nekureba 4 cm, asi kana ukanamatidza mativi e 3 cm, haisi rectangle.
z-m-07-06.s.s3.model.1: Zvinoenderana nedivi rinonamatidzwa. Kana ukanamatidza mativi marefu zvikuru unogona kugadzira rectangle, asi kana ukanamatidza mativi mapfupi e 4 cm haisi rectangle.
z-m-07-06.s.s3.modelNote.1: Kungonyora 'divi pfupi' zvakanaka, asi kunyora hurefu kunoita kuti zvijeke zvakawanda.

z-m-07-10.title: Tinogona kutaura chii nezvemabhegi maviri kubva pamhedzisiro dzakadhirowwa naSeoha naHaram?
z-m-07-10.topic: Mhedzisiro inogona kusiyana kunyange pasi pemamiriro akafanana (possibility)
z-m-07-10.goal: Ziva kuti haugoni kupedzisa kuti mabhegi maviri akasiyana kubva pamhedzisiro mishoma yekudhirowa ka10, uye utaure kuti mhedzisiro dzinoshanda sezvinongedzo kusvika kupi nekuti ungatarisa sei zvakawanda.
z-m-07-10.material:
Pane mabhegi maviri ane marbles matsvuku nebhuruu akasanganiswa (Bhegi 가, Bhegi 나). Hatizivi marbles mangani ari mubhegi rimwe nerimwe kana kuti mabhegi maviri akafanana kana akasiyana. Seoha akatora marble imwe kubva muBhegi 가 uye Haram akatora imwe kubva muBhegi 나, akatarisa ruvara rwayo, ndokuidzorera, achizviita ka10 imwe neimwe.
Bhegi 가 (Seoha): tsvuku ka7, bhuruu ka3
Bhegi 나 (Haram): tsvuku ka4, bhuruu ka6
Seoha akati, 'Bhegi rangu rine tsvuku dzakawanda uye bhegi raHaram rine bhuruu dzakawanda. Mabhegi maviri akasiyana!'
z-m-07-10.thinking.0: Ongorora kana mhedzisiro oga dzichibvumira mhedziso
z-m-07-10.thinking.2: Rongedza uye unyore kutonga kwako nehumboo hwako
z-m-07-10.prereq.0: Verenga zvinogona kuitika nehuwandu hwenguva uye uzvironge mutafura
z-m-07-10.prereq.1: Zvinoreva zvezuva nezuva zve 'zvinogoneka/zvisingagoneki' ne 'zvechokwadi' (nhanho yeGrade 3)
z-m-07-10.s.s1.prompt: Unofunga sei nezvezvakataurwa naSeoha? Sarudza zvakakodzera zvakanyanya kubva pamhedzisiro iyi oga.
z-m-07-10.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora mhedzisiro yaSeoha nemhedzisiro yaHaram padivi pemumwe mutafura.
z-m-07-10.s.s1.hint.1: Fungidzira kuti vaviri vakadhirowwa kubva mubhegi rimwe chete, uye ufunge kana mhedzisiro dzakadaro dzingabuda.
z-m-07-10.s.s1.o.a: Hatigoni kutaura chinhu kubva pamhedzisiro dzakadhirowwa
z-m-07-10.s.s1.r.a: Mhedzisiro idzo chinongedzowo. Unogona kutaura kuti bhegi umo tsvuku dzakabuda dzakawanda rinogona kuva zvishoma nemukana wekuva netsvuku dzakawanda. Kupfuurira kumhedziso nekufuratira chinongedzo zvinhu zvakasiyana.
z-m-07-10.s.s1.o.b: Bhegi 가 rine tsvuku dzakawanda uye bhegi 나 rine bhuruu dzakawanda
z-m-07-10.s.s1.r.b: Uku kutonga kwakagamuchira mashoko aSeoha sezvaakaita. Funga kana mhedzisiro dzekudhirowa ka10 dzingasiyana zvakadaro kunyange kubva mubhegi rimwe chete.
z-m-07-10.s.s1.o.c: Bhegi 가 rine tsvuku 7 uye bhegi 나 rine tsvuku 4
z-m-07-10.s.s1.r.c: Huwandu hwenguva dzakadhirowwa hahusi huwandu hwema marbles. Sezvo marble yakadzorerwa nguva dzose, marble imwe chete inogona kuva yakadhirowwa kakawanda.
z-m-07-10.s.s1.o.d: Kubva pakudhirowa ka10 chete, hatigoni kupedzisa kuti mabhegi maviri akasiyana
z-m-07-10.s.s1.r.d: Uku kutonga kunogamuchira mhedzisiro sechinongedzo asi kunoona kuti kutarisa kwakawanda kunodiwa. Rangarira kuti mhedzisiro dzinogona kusiyana kunyange kubva mubhegi rimwe chete.
z-m-07-10.s.s1.explain: Kunyange kubva mubhegi rimwe chete, kana ukadhirowa ka10 imwe neimwe, tsvuku inogona kuuya ka7 kana ka4. Saka kunyange mhedzisiro dzichisiyana, haugoni kupedzisa kuti mabhegi maviri akasiyana. Asi izvozvo hazvireve kuti mhedzisiro hadzina chinongedzo zvachose. Unogona kutaura kuti divi umo tsvuku dzakabuda dzakawanda rine mukana wakakwirira zvishoma wekuva netsvuku dzakawanda.
z-m-07-10.s.s2.prompt: Nzira dzipi dzaizobatsira kuziva zviri nani kana mabhegi maviri akafanana kana akasiyana? Sarudza nzira dzose dzinobatsira.
z-m-07-10.s.s2.hint.0: Kune nzira imwe neimwe, nyora ruzivo rutsva rwaungadzidza mushure mekuishandisa.
z-m-07-10.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa kuti kuvimba mhedzisiro dzekutanga kunosiyana sei nekuunganidza mhedzisiro itsva.
z-m-07-10.s.s2.o.a: Rimwe nerimwe rinowedzera huwandu hwekudhirowa uye rinobatanidza mhedzisiro
z-m-07-10.s.s2.r.a: Sezvo huwandu hwekudhirowa huchikura, mhedzisiro dzinoswedera padhuze neratio yema marbles mubhegi, saka chinongedzo chinova chinovimbika zvakanyanya.
z-m-07-10.s.s2.o.b: Vimba divi umo tsvuku dzakabuda dzakawanda mumhedzisiro dzazvino
z-m-07-10.s.s2.r.b: Kuvimba mhedzisiro dzaripo sezvadziri hakuwedzeri ruzivo rutsva, saka hakuiti kuti kutonga kwekutanga kuve kwechokwadi zvakanyanya.
z-m-07-10.s.s2.o.c: Vaviri vega vanodhirowa kamwe chete zvakare uye vanosarudza neruvara rwekudhirowa iko kumwe chete
z-m-07-10.s.s2.r.c: Kana ukasarudza nemhedzisiro yekudhirowa kamwe zvakare, haugoni kutaura chinhu. Unofanira kuunganidza mhedzisiro yekudhirowa kakawanda kuita chinongedzo.
z-m-07-10.s.s2.o.d: Bvisa marbles ose uye uaverenge neruvara
z-m-07-10.s.s2.r.d: Kana ukavabvisa ukavaverenga zvakananga, unogona kuva nechokwadi zvakanyanya kana mabhegi maviri akafanana. Asi kana iri mutambo umo usingagoni kuvabvisa, haugoni kuishandisa.
z-m-07-10.s.s2.explain: Kuwedzera huwandu hwekudhirowa nekubatanidza kunoita kuti chinongedzo chivimbike, uye kubvisa nekuverenga marbles ose kunosimbisa zvakananga. Kuvimba mhedzisiro dzazvino sezvadziri kana kudhirowa kamwe chete zvakare hazvitaure ruzivo rutsva zvachose.
z-m-07-10.s.s2.acc.0: Kana iri mutambo umo usingagoni kuvabvisa uye kuvaverenga, kuwedzera huwandu hwekudhirowa nekubatanidza ndiyo nzira yakanakisa.
z-m-07-10.s.s2.acc.1: Kana ukavabvisa ukavaverenga, unogona kuziva nechokwadi. Zvaizova zvakanakawo kufunga nzira yekuwedzera huwandu hwekudhirowa, kana usingagoni kuvabvisa.
